title: Testing agents with evals
summary: You can't unit-test a vibe. Evals score an agent on real tasks so changes don't silently make it worse.

steps.label: 120 tasks
steps.title: A fixed set of real tasks
steps.text: Collect real user requests, including the ones that failed before. Each has a way to check success.

steps.label: trace
steps.title: Check what can be checked with code
steps.text: Exact checks are cheap and reliable: right tool called, valid JSON, tests pass, under budget.

steps.label: reply
steps.title: Use a model for fuzzy qualities
steps.text: For tone, helpfulness or accuracy, a second model grades against a written rubric. Spot-check the judge against human ratings.
payload: polite · explains next steps · no false promises

steps.label: gate
steps.title: Block regressions
steps.text: Run evals on every prompt or model change, like tests in CI. A 3-point drop means read the failing traces before shipping.
